rows.question: Look me in the eye and tell me you're innocent.
rows.line: I don't need to look anywhere to tell you what you already know—I'm the victim here, and my insurance adjusters are standing by. Next question.

rows.question: Look me in the eye and tell me you're innocent.
rows.line: I am innocent; record that without embellishment. The missing asset is my loss, not my motive. Next question.

rows.question: Jin says he'll tell me everything tomorrow.
rows.line:
You think Jin speaks for me? He's my employee. He does what I tell him.

Next question.

rows.question: Jin says he'll tell me everything tomorrow.
rows.line: Think carefully about what your family does when your job quietly stops existing. People forget who they work for, and I don’t.

rows.question: Jin says he'll tell me everything tomorrow.
rows.line: Jin’s family relies on the harbor for their livelihood, and he would be wise to remember who signs his checks. My lawyer will ensure he stays silent. Next question.

rows.question: Jin says he'll tell me everything tomorrow.
rows.line: Tomorrow is his choice. Remind him his family’s livelihood—and your position—depend on keeping this orderly. Next question.

rows.question: Any last thing you want to say before I go?
rows.line: Enjoy the walk out, Detective—you lost this before you sat down. My lawyers will make sure it stays that way.

rows.question: Any last thing you want to say before I go?
rows.line: You've had your opportunity to ask the right questions, Detective. I suggest you use your remaining time more productively than wasting mine. Next question.

rows.question: Any last thing you want to say before I go?
rows.line: My legal team is already drafting the paperwork for your formal reprimand regarding this disruption of my assets. Next question. Enjoy the long walk back to your precinct while I decide how quickly your career ends.

rows.question: Any last thing you want to say before I go?
rows.line: The Black Diamond remains my asset, and you’ve gained nothing worth my time. Next question.
